action_items.task: Find out more about the 'advanced chip on print' design (whether it is micro-processor based) from the technology background.
Consider who will manufacture the custom cases and learn about labor laws.
Find out the cost of adding a display.
Come up with the prototype model.
Come up with the marketing strategy.

decisions.text: The team decided to stick with the simple design without a display for now.
The team agreed on a customizable mahogany red wooden case.
The team decided buttons will be rubber, not wood.

notes:
## Case Material and Design
- Rubber, plastic, and titanium were eliminated; wood was selected as the environmentally friendly case material.
- The case was specified as a customizable mahogany red wooden case.
- Buttons will remain rubber to maintain tactile experience, rather than being made of wood.
## Electronics and Features
- The team agreed on an advanced chip-on-print design that includes an infrared sender and integrated sensors.
- The team decided to stick with the simple design without a display for now until the cost of adding one is confirmed.
- Features include an ergonomic molded shape, a flip screen to lock the remote, and a battery life indicator.
## Manufacturing and Customization
- The team decided to establish a business tie-up with a fabric manufacturer rather than building their own factory.
- Customization involves a foam rubber ball sent to customers to capture hand geometry and squeeze resistance to determine the appropriate wood type.
tldr: The team finalized the design for a new remote control featuring a customizable mahogany red wooden case with rubber buttons and an advanced chip-on-print design. They decided to omit the display for now to control costs and agreed on a manufacturing strategy involving a fabric manufacturer tie-up rather than building a factory.
